propositions: Add .github/module-size-limit.txt containing 800 as the single source of the module-size limit read by both the CI gate and the contract test.
Rewrite the Module-size gate step in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml to enforce an absolute 800 LOC cap on src/rebar/**/*.py with no allowlist or exemptions.

Implement a limit lock that fetches main by explicit GitHub URL, reads the limit file via git cat-file, fails with a 'must override' error when BASE differs from LIMIT, and bootstraps when main lacks the file.
The gate must warn (not silently skip) and fall through to the absolute cap when the main fetch fails, and must fail when the limit file is missing.
Replace test_module_size_contract.py to read the cap from the limit file and drop allowlist/ceilings sync assertions.
Keep the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files in this change so main's current gate stays green, deferring their deletion to Phase 2b.
